title: Tell Bonaventure the Truth or Lie

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: You’re back! I mean, good to see you're back. Did you… ahem... have you done any sailing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’re back! I mean, good to see you're back. Did you… ahem... have you done any sailing?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: And...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And...?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Nothing? Nothing. Then he’s out there still, somewhere. Maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing? Nothing. Then he’s out there still, somewhere. Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I know... but another day won’t hurt. Maybe he’ll find his way back here. And when he does, I’ll be waiting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know... but another day won’t hurt. Maybe he’ll find his way back here. And when he does, I’ll be waiting.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I knew you would. I felt it, all those years ago. Like someone had wrapped a fishing line around my heart and tossed it into the sea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew you would. I felt it, all those years ago. Like someone had wrapped a fishing line around my heart and tossed it into the sea.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Now? I suppose it is time for me to stop waiting. Perhaps I’ll go to the sea after all. Visit the Rigs. I’d like to see the place where he rests.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now? I suppose it is time for me to stop waiting. Perhaps I’ll go to the sea after all. Visit the Rigs. I’d like to see the place where he rests.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: This place? Just a shell. An empty bottle without a message. Have it. The license is yours. I’m cutting myself loose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This place? Just a shell. An empty bottle without a message. Have it. The license is yours. I’m cutting myself loose.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Maybe. Perhaps he’ll feel my presence there. But at least I’ll be able to see a new horizon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe. Perhaps he’ll feel my presence there. But at least I’ll be able to see a new horizon.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I hope he knew that I was thinking about him, at the end. That I will always think about him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope he knew that I was thinking about him, at the end. That I will always think about him.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Everything... just everything. One day you will know. Or maybe you won't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everything... just everything. One day you will know. Or maybe you won't.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: That's what you're after? It's all business? Have it. The license is yours. I’m cutting myself loose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what you're after? It's all business? Have it. The license is yours. I’m cutting myself loose.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Oh what does it say, I can't read it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh what does it say, I can't read it.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Ha. Alright, it was worth a try.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha. Alright, it was worth a try.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Thank you. I... think I will move to the old rig.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you. I... think I will move to the old rig.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I found nothing, sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I found nothing, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I found this name plaque close to a wreck near the Rigs, just like you said.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I found this name plaque close to a wreck near the Rigs, just like you said.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I found this name plaque close to a wreck near the Rigs, just like you said.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I found this name plaque close to a wreck near the Rigs, just like you said.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You should move on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should move on.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will you do now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will you do now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And your business?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And your business?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will I see you on the Rigs?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will I see you on the Rigs?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Will I see you on the Rigs?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Will I see you on the Rigs?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What would that change?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What would that change?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And now? Your business?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And now? Your business?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The boat was called the Annabel Lee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The boat was called the Annabel Lee.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The boat was called the Annabel Lee.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The boat was called the Annabel Lee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Gone Fishing" or something like that. It wasn't the Annabel Lee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Gone Fishing" or something like that. It wasn't the Annabel Lee.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: "Gone Fishing" or something like that. It wasn't the Annabel Lee.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: "Gone Fishing" or something like that. It wasn't the Annabel Lee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you should move on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you should move on.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry for your loss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry for your loss.
